hero.title: NUTRITION MUST ADAPT TO YOU,
hero.subtitle: Honest nutritional education without rigid diets or quick fixes. We work with your metabolism to build metabolic flexibility, autonomy, and sustainable progress.

manifestoSection.title: WE WORK WITH METABOLISM, NOT AGAINST IT.
manifestoSection.subtitle: A rigid system creates dependency, but an adaptable system creates autonomy.
manifestoSection.principle1Desc: Establishing a solid metabolic foundation and reducing digestive stress before demanding high performance.
manifestoSection.principle2Desc: Analyzing how your body responds to environment, rest, and food before adjusting your structure.
manifestoSection.principle3Desc: Making progressive micro-adjustments based on real signals instead of scrapping your plan to start from scratch.

carousel.slide1Desc: LOW, MOD, or HIGH days tailored to your training, rest, and daily activity demands to optimize energy and body composition.
carousel.slide2Desc: Performance does not depend only on what you eat, but on how you rest, organize yourself, and relate to food.
carousel.slide3Title: A System That Evolves With You
carousel.slide3Desc: Nutrition ceases to be a source of worry and becomes a stable support for building well-being over the years.

method.title: THE ORIGIN — NARRATIVE & STRUCTURE
method.subtitle: Recovering what is natural and putting fundamentals back in the spotlight. Food becomes a stable support for well-being.
method.step1Desc: Clearing away misinformation and understanding your biochemistry to eliminate anxiety and tense relationships with food.
method.step2Desc: Precision nutritional strategy featuring low, moderate, and high days based on your actual signals and demands.
method.step3Desc: Synergy between nutrition, functional movement, and circadian habits without emotional burnout.
method.step4Desc: Continuous evaluation and micro-adjustments so health no longer feels like an obligation, but a coherent part of life.

trident.title: STRATEGIC & INTEGRAL NUTRITION
